scope: public manuscript, documentation, website source, tests, and citation metadata in this repository

public_repository_content.description: Version-controlled material already approved for this public repository.

third_party_content.description: Sources, logos, and other material whose rights remain with their owners.

governed_or_sensitive_data.description: Indigenous, community-governed, personal, confidential, export-controlled, embargoed, credential, precise sensitive-location, or otherwise restricted material.

approved_compute.name: owner-authorized local workspace
approved_compute.purpose: editing, local builds, and tests using public repository content
approved_compute.network: deny unless the task or approved service list requires it

approved_compute.name: GitHub Actions
approved_compute.purpose: public-repository CI checks and manually confirmed website deployment

approved_external_services.purpose: version control, issues, CI, and manually approved public website deployment

approved_external_services.service: Crossref, DOI resolvers, publishers, and W3C source pages listed in citation_audit_v2.json
approved_external_services.data: public citation identifiers and metadata only

model_policy.approved_for_public_repository_assistanc: owner-authorized interactive coding or writing agent; record service and exposed model/version for consequential runs
model_policy.rule: No model or service is pre-approved for governed or sensitive data. Stop and obtain legitimate authority plus an approved compute plan before use.

logging.prompt_log: append-only in Git for public, non-sensitive project prompts
logging.retention: retained with repository history while scientifically or administratively relevant; review at each release
logging.minimization: record what is needed to reconstruct consequential work, not private reasoning or unrelated content
logging.redaction: never commit secrets, personal data, governed knowledge, sensitive locations, or security details; use a typed redaction marker and private authorized record where required

required_evidence: passing repository, manuscript, citation, and website checks
human review of scientific claims and disclosure
licenses and permissions appropriate to the release
rights-holder approval for any governed material
